answer: Put every new identity on probation: it may answer, but its attestations weigh little and its rewards stay locked until it survives several epochs of honest work — like ivory carved slowly before it holds value. A sybil farmer can forge an island of fake accounts overnight, yet each must be fed and kept clean for weeks before it earns anything, and one junk verdict resets its clock to zero. Limit: honest newcomers wait too, and a patient farm can still mature its fakes.
